name: Dense Discovery

sources.title: Archive issue — confirms free tips route (new@densediscovery.com), paid classifieds (densediscovery.com/classified.php), and issue sponsorship
Homepage — returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher (bot-blocked, site is live per archive/search index)

conditions: Free route is an editorial tip email to new@densediscovery.com — the editor (Kai Brach) hand-picks what appears; no submission guarantee
Guaranteed placement requires paid classified ad or issue sponsorship via the advertise page
requirements: Weekly newsletter on design, tech, sustainability, urbanism, culture — product must fit that editorial sensibility
Tips are explicitly solicited: 'Send us your suggestions for GIFs, apps, accessories, visual inspiration, etc. to new@densediscovery.com'
Paid paths: classified ads ('promote your project, advertise a job opening, find beta testers') and main issue sponsorship
preparation: A short, non-salesy tip email: what the product is, why DD's design/tech-culture audience would care
For paid: classified ad copy and budget via densediscovery.com/classified.php
If pitching free, position as a discovery the editor would genuinely share — not a PR blast
workflow: Free: email new@densediscovery.com with the product suggestion
Paid: book a classified ad at https://www.densediscovery.com/classified.php or a main sponsor slot via /advertise/
Classifieds run in the weekly issue; sponsor slots book out ahead (waitlist exists for future openings)
watchFor: Site 403s automated fetches — browse interactively; pricing details live on the JS/bot-protected pages
The free route has no SLA — it is editorial curation, not a form
DD's own ad guidance favors 'sequence' campaigns (sponsor + spaced classifieds) over one-off blasts
Newsletter tone is deliberately anti-hype; marketing-heavy pitches are unlikely to be picked
countsAsLive: The product appears in a published DD issue (archive at densediscovery.com/archive/<n>) either as an editorial pick in a section or as a labeled classified/sponsor block
unknowns: Current classified and sponsorship prices (advertise page was bot-blocked)
Editorial response rate or turnaround for tip emails
Whether links in the newsletter are tracked/redirected
